notes: Your own discount and delivery rules are now worked out against the actual order instead of left to the AI to notice. An order a rupee short is told so, and told what it would get; where two discounts could apply the better one is used and the next one named. A customer's own figure can be repeated back to them, which is what used to send 'I have an order worth PKR 499,999' round both providers and out the other side. Asking about delivery no longer drags in a product from three turns ago.
